source: Working tree on top of the source base

criteria: One shared CRON wall-clock algorithm skips gaps and takes the first occurrence of repeated local time. Browser shows UTC and configured zone offset.
Runtime records skipped windows and exhausted budget, preserves unchanged due slots and coalesces additional missed slots. Persisted legacy slots are honored once.
Concurrent PATCH and toggle under runtime RLS yield one winner. Stale DELETE and new manual request are refused; accepted request replays after firing.
Chromium and scoped HTTP read a saved-event preview without creating a pipeline run.
PostgreSQL verifies cooldown, hourly budget, deduplication by persisted event and replay by transport UUID.
Task result ancestry stops A to B to A. Depth and root limits hold, including concurrent contenders in different rules.
